The dial features intricate markings, including numerical scales and weather condition text (e.g., 'STORMY', 'RAIN', 'CHANGE', 'FAIR'). A black pointer hand indicates the current pressure. The background is an out-of-focus urban or semi-outdoor setting with a tiled wall featuring mosaic art and a partial view of a statue or figure to the right. The lighting is bright, causing significant glare and reflections on the glass cover.
